rule: Every imported upstream file is either still byte-identical, declared adapted here with a reason, or declared removed. An adaptation that did not change the bytes, or a rewrite that was never declared, fails scripts/check-extraction.mjs.

adapted.reason: The upstream store also owned user settings, usage history, probe results and a proxy key ring. Those belong to the account channels this package does not have, so the file keeps only the data-directory resolution the lane needs.

The upstream egress layer carries the outlet ladder, the lane-exit pool and the loopback CONNECT relay: routing for a paid, multi-account channel. One anonymous lane has nothing to choose between, so the file is one function with one transport.

removed.reason: It existed to restrict file permissions for the settings and key-ring stores, which are gone; nothing in the kept closure imports it any more.
